file_insights.purpose: Comprehensive website structure and social integration analysis
key_findings: selfrules.org is a Next.js 14 neobrutalist website with bilingual support (IT/EN)
Current social presence limited to footer links only (LinkedIn, Twitter, GitHub, Email)
Hero section contains highly shareable content: failure-to-success narrative
Journey timeline section (4 career phases) provides rich content for social repurposing
WorkTogether section describes 3 services (Consulting, Brainstorming, Mentorship)
Open Graph metadata partially configured but missing OG images
Twitter handle inconsistency detected: @mattiadluca in metadata vs @Matt_Selfrules in footer

file_insights.purpose: Track completion status of audit subtasks across 6 phases
Detailed implementation plan for social media strategy audit

patterns_discovered.description: Multiple sections of the website contain rich content suitable for social media distribution
examples: Hero section messaging can be condensed into LinkedIn hooks
Journey timeline can be converted to LinkedIn carousel posts
Service descriptions (WorkTogether) each represent standalone social content
WhatImUpTo section provides weekly update material
patterns_discovered.impact: HIGH - Can generate 4+ weeks of quality content from existing page content

patterns_discovered.description: Social metadata configuration is partially complete with several inconsistencies
examples: Open Graph images not configured despite foundation being present
Twitter handle mismatch between layout.tsx (@mattiadluca) and Footer.tsx (@Matt_Selfrules)
Homepage-specific OG overrides exist but lack associated images
patterns_discovered.impact: MEDIUM - Affects social card appearance and profile consistency

patterns_discovered.description: Website has tracking hooks in place but social-specific tracking is incomplete
examples: Social click tracking implemented with platform identification
No measurement for social sharing effectiveness or traffic attribution
patterns_discovered.impact: MEDIUM - Foundation exists to measure social strategy effectiveness

patterns_discovered.description: Site supports Italian and English with i18n routing but social strategy must account for dual language needs
examples: Different audience dynamics per language on social platforms
Potential for dual-language posting strategy on LinkedIn
patterns_discovered.impact: MEDIUM - Requires strategic decision on per-platform language approach

patterns_discovered.description: Blog system is designed but not yet active, with social integration planned
examples: Social sharing components referenced in backlog
patterns_discovered.impact: MEDIUM - Upcoming feature will significantly expand social content generation capacity

gotchas_discovered.description: Metadata references @mattiadluca but footer links to @Matt_Selfrules
gotchas_discovered.resolution: Determine primary Twitter handle and update metadata to match actual account

gotchas_discovered.description: OG metadata configured in layout but no actual image assets specified
gotchas_discovered.impact: Social cards will display with default placeholder instead of branded image
gotchas_discovered.resolution: Generate OG images for homepage and create image generation strategy for future blog posts

gotchas_discovered.description: Blog directory structure planned but not active; significant planned social features depend on it
gotchas_discovered.dependencies: Blocks full implementation of blog-based social strategy
gotchas_discovered.resolution: Coordinate social media strategy timeline with blog launch schedule

gotchas_discovered.description: Sections contain highly shareable content but lack share buttons or mechanisms
gotchas_discovered.impact: Friction for users who want to amplify content organically
gotchas_discovered.resolution: Add social sharing buttons to Journey, WorkTogether, and WhatImUpTo sections

gotchas_discovered.description: No follower counts, testimonials, or social credibility signals integrated into website
gotchas_discovered.impact: Reduces trust signals for B2B professional services offering
gotchas_discovered.resolution: Add social proof components after social following reaches threshold

approach_outcome.objective: Analyze website structure and social integration points
methodology: Deep code analysis of Next.js component structure
Mapping social integration points across sections
key_outcomes: Documented 9 major website sections with social relevance
Mapped current social presence (footer links with tracking)
Assessed Open Graph and Twitter card configuration status
approach_outcome.downstream_impact: Provides foundation data for subtask-1-2 (social media presence research) and subtask-1-3 (audience analysis)
approach_outcome.next_steps: Research current social media presence across platforms to compare planned strategy with existing reach and engagement

recommendations.rationale: Metadata mismatch will cause incorrect social card attribution and brand confusion
recommendations.implementation: Identify primary handle, update app/layout.tsx, and verify consistency across all platforms

recommendations.recommendation: Create LinkedIn carousel from Journey Timeline section
recommendations.rationale: Timeline spans 13 years of career progression with 4 distinct phases - ideal carousel format. Immediate content with no dependencies
recommendations.implementation: Extract 4 milestones as individual cards: Designer → Developer → PO → PM. Add lessons learned per phase
recommendations.expected_reach: High engagement on LinkedIn (timeline/carousel format has 2.3x higher engagement)

recommendations.recommendation: Generate and configure Open Graph images
recommendations.rationale: Currently missing OG images despite metadata configuration. Improves click-through rate on social shares
recommendations.implementation: Create 1200x630px OG image template. Configure in next/image. Template should feature: brand colors, value proposition, QR to site
recommendations.expected_impact: Estimated 15-25% increase in social click-through rate

recommendations.recommendation: Develop 3-post series from WorkTogether service cards
recommendations.rationale: Each service (Consulting, Brainstorming, Mentorship) has clear problem/solution structure. LinkedIn format: Problem → Solution → CTA
recommendations.implementation: Create posts: 1) Consulting (cross-functional alignment), 2) Brainstorming (decision-making), 3) Mentorship (PM development)

recommendations.recommendation: Add social sharing buttons to high-value content sections
recommendations.rationale: Hero, Journey, and WorkTogether sections are designed to be shared. Reduces friction for organic amplification
recommendations.implementation: Implement share button component using lucide-react icons. Add to sections with highest engagement potential
recommendations.expected_benefit: Enable user-generated amplification of brand content

recommendations.rationale: Can currently track social clicks but not attribution from social → booking. Needed to measure ROI
recommendations.implementation: Add UTM parameters to social links. Track booking completions by referrer. Create dashboard in Umami
recommendations.business_value: Critical for measuring social channel ROI

recommendations.recommendation: Synchronize social strategy timeline with blog launch (EPIC-006)
recommendations.rationale: Blog will significantly expand content generation capacity. Current strategy phase should anticipate blog content
recommendations.implementation: Confirm EPIC-006 timeline. Plan for 2-4 blog posts/month once launched. Design social amplification workflow for blog posts
recommendations.strategic_value: Ensures social strategy evolves with product roadmap

recommendations.recommendation: Plan social proof integration for future implementation
recommendations.rationale: Missing testimonials, follower counts, and engagement signals. Can be added once social following reaches 500+ on primary platform
recommendations.implementation: Design social proof component template. Identify testimonial collection mechanism. Plan integration points
recommendations.timing: Implement after 6 weeks of consistent social posting
